notes: All photos verified visually as Hotel El Prado, Barranquilla (barrio El Prado). photo-1: garden view across the famous central pool toward the central tower and arched colonnade wing (SW angle). photo-2: wide view of the central pool framed by both U-shaped arcaded wings with heraldic crests and La Cabana restaurant stair. photo-3: corner view up the cream tower with rooftop 'Hotel el Prado' sign, navy scalloped awnings over entry doors. photo-4: street-side entrance porte-cochère (arched gate) and palm-lined driveway along the north-west wing façade. Rejected candidates: an interior event-hall shot and a heavily palm-obstructed courtyard view.
